integrity.proof_basis: An exact product coefficient identity, necessary and sufficient profile criterion, and exhaustive 21147-partition computation independently cross-checked by two Python 3 programs.

scientific_limitations: Complete only for the nine-element three-by-three rectangular band, not arbitrary rectangular bands.
Classification is up to semigroup automorphisms, not up to arbitrary algebra isomorphisms.
Numerical case split is an exact exhaustive finite computation; it is not an infinite-family theorem.
Absolute historical priority has not been independently verified.
title: Twelve automorphism types of Schur rings on the three-by-three rectangular band
